svg.title: Shared rehab cactus planter · #1 plant portrait
svg.desc: A tall pale cream-streaked blue-green column rises behind a shorter green golden-spined torch and softly hairy curved monkey-tail stems in the broad dark etched round planter shared by P19 / #1.
